stories.title: Union Cabinet approves raising EPFO wage ceiling to ₹25,000 per month

en.title: Union Cabinet approves raising EPFO wage ceiling to ₹25,000 per month
en.summary: The Indian Cabinet has approved an increase in the EPFO wage ceiling to ₹25,000 monthly. The government expects this change to extend mandatory EPFO coverage to over 51 lakh additional employees.

stories.title: Cabinet approves raising EPFO wage ceiling from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000

en.title: Cabinet approves raising EPFO wage ceiling from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000
en.summary: The Cabinet has raised the EPFO wage ceiling from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000, reflecting wage growth since the previous limit was set in 2014. The ceiling had remained at Rs 15,000 for a decade before this update.

stories.title: Madras High Court rejects plea challenging election of DMK whip E.V. Velu from Tiruvannamalai constituency

en.title: Madras High Court rejects plea challenging election of DMK whip E.V. Velu from Tiruvannamalai constituency
en.summary: The Madras High Court has dismissed a petition challenging the election of DMK whip E.V. Velu from Tiruvannamalai constituency. The court granted the former Minister's applications to strike off the pleadings and reject the election petition.

stories.title: Messi match row: Kerala police raid TV channel office

en.title: Messi match row: Kerala police raid TV channel office
en.summary: Kerala police have conducted a raid on a television channel office related to a Messi match dispute.

stories.title: India, Pakistan naval vessels collide; MEA summons Pakistan envoy in New Delhi

en.title: India, Pakistan naval vessels collide; MEA summons Pakistan envoy in New Delhi
en.summary: Indian and Pakistani naval vessels collided at sea, leading India to lodge a protest against Pakistan's naval units for unprofessional conduct. India's Ministry of External Affairs summoned Pakistan's envoy in New Delhi.

stories.title: 9-year-old saw mother stab father, Rajasthan High Court denies plea to suspend life term

en.title: 9-year-old saw mother stab father, Rajasthan High Court denies plea to suspend life term
en.summary: A Rajasthan High Court rejected a plea to suspend a life sentence in a case where a 9-year-old child witnessed their mother fatally stabbing their father.

stories.title: Pak Ship Collides With Indian Navy Unit, Delhi Summons Islamabad's Envoy

en.title: Pak Ship Collides With Indian Navy Unit, Delhi Summons Islamabad's Envoy
en.summary: A Pakistani ship collided with an Indian Navy vessel in international waters, prompting India's Foreign Ministry to summon Pakistan's envoy to address the incident.

stories.title: Messi visit row: Keralam CM denies police disrupted news operations at Reporter TV office during searches

en.title: Messi visit row: Keralam CM denies police disrupted news operations at Reporter TV office during searches
en.summary: Kerala's Chief Minister denied allegations that police disrupted news operations at Reporter TV during searches, stating that a search warrant was obtained from magistrate court for the television channel's Kochi office.

stories.title: Woman unaware of husband’s first marriage not bigamy offender: Madras High Court

en.title: Woman unaware of husband's first marriage not bigamy offender: Madras High Court
en.summary: The Madras High Court ruled that a woman who was unaware of her husband's prior marriage is not guilty of bigamy in relation to her own marriage.

stories.title: ‘Came close at high speed’: What led to India-Pakistan naval collision at Arabian Sea

en.title: 'Came close at high speed': What led to India-Pakistan naval collision at Arabian Sea
en.summary: Indian and Pakistani naval vessels came into close contact at high speed in the Arabian Sea, according to reports detailing the incident.

stories.title: Resigned MLAs seeking re-election in bypolls may amount to insulting voters: Madras High Court judge

en.title: Resigned MLAs seeking re-election in bypolls may amount to insulting voters: Madras High Court judge
en.summary: A Madras High Court judge suggested that legislators who resign and then seek re-election in subsequent bypolls may be disrespecting voters, questioning whether the Election Commission should establish guidelines on the matter.

stories.title: India, Pakistani naval ships collide in international waters; MEA calls conduct 'unprofessional'

en.title: India, Pakistani naval ships collide in international waters; MEA calls conduct 'unprofessional'
en.summary: Naval vessels from India and Pakistan collided in international waters, with India's Ministry of External Affairs characterizing the Pakistani conduct as unprofessional.

stories.title: Sensex rises 400 points, Nifty nears 23,250 as investors await Fed meeting outcome. What to expect?

en.title: Sensex rises 400 points, Nifty nears 23,250 as investors await Fed meeting outcome. What to expect?
en.summary: Indian stock indices rebounded approximately 0.5% on Wednesday following the previous day's decline. Investors are monitoring the Federal Reserve's upcoming policy decision while elevated US bond yields and crude prices continue to affect market sentiment.

stories.title: Solar Industries shares plunge 17% in 2 days. Why Jefferies, Nuvama still see up to 46% upside

en.title: Solar Industries shares plunge 17% in 2 days. Why Jefferies, Nuvama still see up to 46% upside
en.summary: Solar Industries stock fell over 17% in two trading sessions following its acquisition of South Africa's Omnia Holdings for Rs 12,951 crore. Major analysts maintain positive ratings, citing the company's earnings growth potential and strategic expansion benefits from the deal.

stories.title: Paytm wins, but ATM also wins! Why CMS Info Systems shares jumped 7% on UPI MDR

en.title: Paytm wins, but ATM also wins! Why CMS Info Systems shares jumped 7% on UPI MDR
en.summary: CMS Info Systems shares rose following government announcement of merchant discount rates on select UPI transactions exceeding Rs 2,000. The new charges, effective October 15, establish a 0.4% MDR on eligible peer-to-merchant UPI payments.

stories.title: Yes Bank shares jump 4% as Citi, Morgan Stanley see lender as key beneficiary of new UPI charges. Earnings boost ahead?

en.title: Yes Bank shares jump 4% as Citi, Morgan Stanley see lender as key beneficiary of new UPI charges. Earnings boost ahead?
en.summary: Yes Bank shares increased after major financial institutions identified the lender as a primary beneficiary of new MDR charges on select UPI transactions. Analysts expect the charges to provide earnings benefits to banks, though estimates vary on the magnitude of profit impact.

stories.title: Paytm shares jump 7% as Jefferies, other brokerages raise target prices and earnings estimates after new UPI charges

en.title: Paytm shares jump 7% as Jefferies, other brokerages raise target prices and earnings estimates after new UPI charges
en.summary: Paytm's stock price increased following multiple brokerages raising their price targets and earnings forecasts in response to new merchant discount rates on certain UPI transactions exceeding Rs 2,000.
